### Argo CD

**Categories:** CD, GitOps, release and promotion<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, Release Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Declarative GitOps continuous delivery for Kubernetes.

**Use when**

- * You want a mature, UI-rich GitOps controller for Kubernetes with strong multi-cluster support.

**Consider alternatives when**

- * You don't use Kubernetes or prefer a pull-based model without a central server.

[Official site](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) · [Documentation](https://argo-cd.readthedocs.io/en/stable/) · [Source repository](https://github.com/argoproj/argo-cd)

### ArgoCD Vault Plugin

**Categories:** CD, GitOps, release and promotion, IAM, secrets and certificate management<br>
**Roles:** DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Platform Engineer, DevSecOps Engineer, Release Engineer, Cloud Security Engineer<br>
**Model:** Oss<br>
**Status:** Active

Integrates secrets from external stores into ArgoCD.

**Use when**

- * You need to inject secrets from Vault/AWS/GCP into ArgoCD-managed manifests.
